content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Columbus

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and professional project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds and education levels required, then document your work history. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether your background qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course delivered by experienced practitioners. Attend all sessions synchronously, engage with instructors and peers in real time, and complete all required coursework. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour prerequisite for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account, log your project-management experience, and submit your official PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute. Pay the associated exam fee and wait for PMI's eligibility audit and approval. Granite PM Academy can guide you through each field to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study guides to reinforce your knowledge of the PMBOK Guide and core project-management domains. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center, then sit for the computer-based assessment. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, earning certifications, volunteering, or publishing project-management work. Submit your PDU record and renewal fee to PMI before your credential expires. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning options to help you meet renewal requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
